notable_absence.finding: This 21-line page is the whole-tree's canonical 'Authentication' landing page, yet it never names a single concrete role or privilege - it stays entirely at the mechanism level (credentials, LDAP, PAM). Consistent with the round's expectation that thin overview pages can carry sparse concept/relation sets.

cross_component_finding: This page states the EE-gating for LDAP/PAM-backed validation as a single alternative clause ('alternatively if the Enterprise Edition... is used'), without separately EE-gating SAML - worth checking against configure-saml.md's own prerequisites, which state no edition restriction at all.
